mechanism: Chlorthalidone causes electrolyte depletion and volume depletion that may increase everolimus levels and nephrotoxicity risk, while everolimus can impair renal function; both agents affect renal hemodynamics and electrolyte balance.
action: Monitor renal function, electrolytes, and everolimus levels regularly; assess volume status and consider alternative antihypertensive if significant renal impairment or hyperkalemia develops.
